answer: The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are published in terrace, expire in ledge, and vault lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 26 aliases hence needs 106 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 3396 identities would post 4317 proofs and burn roughly 61 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
